How We Can Help

Whether you're a business traveler, a relocating professional, or a company housing a team — we have a home for that.

Corporate Housing

Your team flies in Monday. Their apartments are ready Sunday. Fully furnished, utilities included, walking distance to downtown offices.

  • All utilities included
  • High-speed WiFi
  • Housekeeping service
  • 24/7 support

Short-Term Stays

Between leases? Renovating? Just need a beautiful space for a few weeks? Move in with nothing but a suitcase.

  • Minimum 28 nights
  • Fully equipped kitchen
  • Premium locations
  • Instant booking

Property Management

Own a condo in Toronto? We'll fill it, maintain it, and handle everything. You just collect the income.

  • Professional photography
  • Tenant screening
  • Rent collection
  • Maintenance coordination

Personal Concierge

Need groceries before you arrive? Airport pickup? Restaurant recs in your neighborhood? Just ask.

  • Airport pickup
  • Grocery delivery
  • Restaurant reservations
  • Local recommendations

Flexible Leasing

Stay a month, extend to six. No penalties, no paperwork headaches. Your lease works around your life.

  • Month-to-month options
  • No hidden fees
  • Easy renewal
  • Early termination available

Growing Network

Starting in Toronto, expanding to cities where business takes you. One platform, consistent quality everywhere.

  • Toronto
  • Vancouver
  • Montreal
  • New York
  • San Francisco
